scoring.normalization: NFKC; lowercase; curly apostrophe normalization; ASCII alphanumeric and Hangul tokens; generic stopwords; no stemming or name dictionary.
scoring.featureMix: Exact query-token recall .60 + Hangul within-token bigram recall .40; normalize active channels.

scoring.B2: Pool-IDF feature weighting; body .65 + section .20 + title .10 + source .05.
scoring.eligibility: Use original cosine threshold before hybrid scoring; ties resolve by cosine then original rank.
